title: CREATE HUB
description: This build is focused on calm and measured survival using the Create mod and its addons.
body:
![CREATE HUB](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c731e7ab8d9548929ca1d33e15ddb19efc9db3e4.png)

**This build is designed for the most enjoyable and engaging experience with Create and its add-ons, along with other interesting industrial mods.**

- **Add-ons have been incorporated into the Create mod, introducing oil, its refining, and various types of electricity.**
- **Valkyrien Skies physical structures and its add-ons, such as Create: Interactive, Clockwork, and Eureka, have been added.**
- **Full support for external media is included: videos via WATERFRAMES, music via Etched, and pictures via Immersive Paintings.**

**World Generation:**
**Custom generation created using William Wythers' Expanded Ecosphere mod, and larger trees with Tan's Huge Trees mod.**

**Atmosphere:**
- **Particle Rain** — an enhanced rain mod.
- **Immersive Weathering** — gradual block aging (and you can also eat moss there).
- **AmbientSounds** — for the coolest and most atmospheric sounds.
- **Sound Physics Remastered** — to make sounds even better.
- **Exposure** — for taking atmospheric photos of yourself and your friends.
- **Selfexpression and its add-on Selfexpression: Slim** — for changing outfits.

**And, of course, shaders for even more atmosphere:**
- Complementary Shaders - Unbound
- Hysteria Shaders
- Insanity Shader
- Kappa Shader
- Nostalgia Shader
- Photon Shaders
- Solas Shader
- Super Duper Vanilla

**A few optimization mods to prevent lag, and that's about it.**

**Oh, and yes, the build is heavy despite optimizations. It is recommended to allocate 8–10 GB of RAM to Minecraft.**

**Enjoy the game! :>**
